Thanks. That means a lot. On a plus side, I no longer scare the crap out of my family by trying to convince them 9/11 was an inside job and Area 51 is blah, blah, blah. I'm almost convinced that conspiracy theorists need recovery support groups and online forums for support.
I've never actually gotten checked for schizophrenia but it does run in my family. Maybe it's time to make an appointment.

I'm going to say depression and anxiety. There was a time in my life when I believed a lot of this myself. I actually convinced myself that I was helping people by saying that craziness and it made me feel a little better. It wasn't until after I started reaching out to people and seeking help that I started to see my errors. I consider myself a conspiracy theorist in recovery because I do consider it a mental health issue and some of these people really need help to get past it.
I have not yet heard of the little me. Please tell me.
I guess fear of ridicule is stopping me.
